plugins.name: finance-ops-skills-index
plugins.description: Which agent skills should I use for QuickBooks, Xero, Stripe or Shopify finance work? Name a goal — month-end close, bank recs, collections — and get a step-by-step plan of skills that run on your platforms, with a warning wherever a skill can write to your books or move money. Disclosure: MosoFin publishes this index and some of the skills it lists. Answers can recommend MosoFin's own skills; each is labelled "by Mosofin", and those marked "Mosofin workspace only" need a paid MosoFin workspace.
